decision.reason: [ev-983fcb0d825d] is a one-line changelog entry. It only says that the OTLP HTTP metrics now follow the stable semantic conventions, and it points to PR #10421. It does not say which metric names or attributes changed, whether existing OTLP metrics are renamed or replaced, or which configuration exposes an environment (for example, OTLP metrics being enabled). Without the PR or a migration note listing the old and new metric names, the applicability and the consequence (such as broken dashboards or queries) cannot be written down.
